close_reporting: v41: close reports distinguish the active policy exit threshold from the standing protective stop. Execution-quality gap is assessed against the policy threshold; the protective-stop distance is retained as separate context. Fee-pending reports continue to show confirmed gross PnL without claiming confirmed net PnL.
execution_adjusted_ev: raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - max(80 bps, 1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_impact_bps); raw_expected_gross_bps is the explicit MC1 gross convention and the historical 100-bps policy cost is not debited again; must remain at least +50 bps at preflight and after fill
position_monitor: persistent one-minute threshold monitor: stop/trailing/timeout use only post-fill closed 1m bars; the stored Adaptive Exit V1 activation is consumed by the minute executor and is never recomputed there

runtime_reseal_predecessors.reason: v59 differs from v58 only in close-report presentation. It preserves the distinction between the active trailing/timeout policy exit threshold and the standing exchange protective stop, so a market trailing fill is judged against the correct threshold. The separately hash-bound execution module carries the same reporting-only lineage. Model artifacts, feature contract, Geometry/K9, consensus, MC1, admission, policy, execution economics and portfolio rules are byte-identical.

version_note: v64: reporting-only EIGEN close-threshold lineage repair. No model, feature, admission, policy, execution, or portfolio semantics changed.
